description: Beijing Normal University publishes annual global photovoltaic-panel maps for 2019–2022. A two-stage classifier combines Google Earth imagery and Sentinel-2 observations to identify panels at twenty-metre resolution. The Zenodo release supplies annual TIFF archives and a shapefile that indexes four-degree tiles within broader climate regions. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage can support spatial photovoltaic inventories and exposure or capacity-planning simulations alongside data-global-power-plant-database and model-pypsa. A caveat is that mapped panel area is not installed electrical capacity or delivered generation. Image resolution also limits confidence for small or mixed rooftop installations. Tile identifiers and year labels must remain attached when combining files. Metadata and file manifests were checked without downloading imagery, testing classification accuracy or verifying tile completeness.
